description: End-to-end check of the cable-swap harness setup: restore, backup verified against the target, and a playback recording that meets the audio protocol. Replays the 6F first-pair restore, accepted on 2026-10-09, because it differs from the single-tone state the device holds now, so an exact match proves the restore landed.
observation_questions: Did the PO-33 finish receiving without ERR, and did the pattern play? (Enter to skip)
result_summary: Restore with cable swaps landed exactly (backup-03 equals the 6F target, 815 packets). backup-02 was rejected by the echo check (0.14 at 4.5 ms) before the cable swap; playback-02 passed the protocol checks. Session 001 restore did not reach the device (backup equalled the prior single-tone state).
